title: Report Card
story: Marks are turned into grades: 90 or more is A, 75 or more is B, 50 or more is C, anything lower is D.
goal: Read marks and print the grade letter.
starter:
marks = int(input())
# print A, B, C or D
hints: When there are more than two outcomes, chain them: if ... elif ... else.
Check the highest band first: if marks >= 90, then elif marks >= 75, then elif marks >= 50, then else.
socratic: If marks is 95, which conditions are true? Which one should win?
Why does the order of the checks matter?
What does elif do that a second if does not?
explain: In one sentence: why do we check the highest band first?

example.title: Worked example: ticket price
example.note: Conditions are checked top to bottom; the first true one wins.
